entries.title: Jeremiah 28:1
segments: And it happened in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:2
segments: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:3
segments: Within two full years I will again bring into this place all the vessels of the LORD's house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried them to Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:4
segments: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah who went into Babylon, says the LORD. For I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:5
segments: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence all the people who stood in the house of the LORD,

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:6
segments: even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen. May the LORD do [so]. May the LORD confirm your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD's house, and all that is exiled from Babylon into this place.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:7
segments: But hear now this word that I speak in your ears and in the ears of all the people:

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:8
segments: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of plague.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:9
segments: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, [then] the prophet shall be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:10
segments: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck and broke it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:11
segments: And Hananiah spoke for the eyes of all the people, saying, So says the LORD, Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the time of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:12
segments: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:13
segments: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, So says the LORD: You have broken the yokes of wood, but you shall make for them yokes of iron.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:14
segments: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And they shall serve him. And I have given him the beasts of the field also.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:15
segments: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah. The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people to trust in a lie.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:16
segments: Therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will drive you from off the face of the earth. You shall die this year, because you have taught rebellion against the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:17
segments: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
